description: Swap any token into USDC to pay x402 prices, on Base, Arbitrum, Polygon (0x) or Solana (Jupiter). Default: a ready-to-sign swap for your address (taker) with guaranteed minimum, approve step, fees and expiresAt; you sign it. mode=price: quote only, no taker. mode=wallet: your USDC and gas balances, and with needUsdc the swap that covers the gap. mode=pay402: give a 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (invoice) or payUrl and get the swap for exactly what it asks. compare=1 adds KyberSwap's quote. Price: $0.001 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

amount.description: Amount to sell in whole units, e.g. 0.001 (or give sellAmount)

chain.description: base, arbitrum, polygon or solana (default base)

compare.description: 1 = also show KyberSwap's quote for the same sell (EVM chains)

invoice.description: mode=pay402: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64) of an x402 402 answer, or its JSON

mode.description: swap (default; needs sellToken, amount, taker), price (needs sellToken, amount), wallet (needs taker; optional needUsdc), pay402 (needs taker and invoice or payUrl)

needUsdc.description: mode=wallet: USDC you need to hold, e.g. 0.005

payUrl.description: mode=pay402: the https URL that answers 402 (read with a GET)

sellAmount.description: Amount to sell in the token's base units (wei, lamports), instead of amount

sellToken.description: Token to sell: contract address (Solana: mint), ETH/POL/SOL/native for the chain's coin, or WETH

slippageBps.description: Allowed slippage in basis points, 1 to 300 (default 50 = 0.5%)

taker.description: Your wallet address that will sign and send the transaction (0x + 40 hex; Solana: base58 public key)

name: crypto_swap_to_usdc
title: Swap any token into USDC to pay x402 prices, on Base
